mechanism: bounded per-episode public state-action visit and blocked-edge memory; learned-R3-prediction frontier navigation only when stalled; preserve original R3 source and model weights
input_contract: only public observation (x,y,heading,goal,front_blocked) before selected action and actually observed after-state, no whole maze, hidden coordinates or goal oracle
mechanism_falsifiers: unobserved physics cannot be manufactured from episode trajectory
stale FIT wall locations never override fresh real public block observations
no modification of model weights in CHECK/DEV
loop breaker either finds unseen reachable local frontier or explicitly fails closed
terminal/session reset clears episodic visits not learned R3 weights
bounded node visits, counters, and checkpoint authentication
cold OS-process restore preserves learned R3 and bounded episode session only
control_requirements: unchanged R3 code and R3 own trained checkpoint
R4 identical model with frontier disabled
trained fitted dynamics+BFS and equal public-source tabular
trained model-free and recurrent variants where available
future_evaluation: not authorized by mechanism freeze; FORGE must freeze new cohorts and independently qualified controls before any original source episodes
